editorial.blurb: Shan Restaurant and Grocery offers Indo-Pakistani staples with an inconsistent track record—reliable comfort dishes sit alongside concerning quality control issues that warrant caution.
editorial.insiderTip: Stick with the tried-and-true favorites like Dahl Channa, Halwa Puri, lamb and potatoes, or spinach and potatoes that loyal long-term customers praise, and visit during peak hours when food turnover is highest.
